items.project_1_desc: The business-support system behind ~28 white-label mobile carriers: subscriber lifecycle, SIM provisioning, number portability, billing and payments. 108 tables, 371 REST endpoints and a tenant-tree multi-tenancy model with encrypted per-tenant carrier credentials. Largest contributor: 2,094 of 6,649 commits.
items.project_2_desc: Ten payment processors plus OXXO cash references consolidated behind a single charge protocol with per-gateway error persistence and webhook handling. Includes a 26-reason dealer balance ledger with pessimistic locking, a configurable anti-fraud rate limiter and CFDI/SAT e-invoicing.
items.project_3_desc: Led the migration of the consumer mobile ecosystem to Kotlin Multiplatform: one shared codebase (336 files) for Android and iOS with Clean Architecture — 54 use cases, 43 screens, 30 ViewModels, Swift interop and server-driven runtime theming across 6 brands. Authored 63% of the codebase.
items.project_4_desc: Architected and operated the AWS footprint for ~28 white-label brands — 100+ deployments spanning admin CRMs, dashboards, public top-up portals and APIs. Multi-AZ high availability: EC2 Auto Scaling behind ELB, Multi-AZ RDS (PostgreSQL), S3 + CloudFront, Route 53 failover, VPC isolation and CloudWatch monitoring.
items.project_5_desc: Point-of-sale app for the dealer network: SIM activation, customer signup, number portability, IMEI verification and balance purchases. 17 product flavors from one codebase, six payment processors integrated natively and ZXing barcode scanning. Top contributor: 232 of 559 commits.
items.project_6_desc: The internal operations CRM: 118 models, 337 routes and 187 components with shared CRUD base classes, a bitmask-driven permission system and dashboards with chart and PDF export. Deployed per tenant via GitLab CI to S3 + CloudFront. Top contributor: 1,554 of 5,899 commits over 6.5 years.
items.project_7_desc: A multi-tenant CRM frontend for enterprise sales management, built around modular component architecture and integration with complex backend APIs across diverse tenant requirements.
items.project_8_desc: High-performance professional portfolio featuring advanced SVG/3D backgrounds, custom animation systems, and full i18n support. Designed for a premium responsive experience.

experiences.title: Tech Lead / Senior Full-Stack Engineer
achievements: Platform Ownership: Owned the core multi-tenant Ruby on Rails MVNO platform (108 tables, 371 REST endpoints, ~95K LOC) powering ~28 white-label telecom brands — largest contributor with 2,094 of 6,649 commits. Architected multi-tenancy as a tenant tree with encrypted per-tenant carrier credentials.

Payment Systems: Unified 10 payment gateways (Openpay, Stripe, Conekta/FEMSA, MercadoPago, Kushki, Clip, Toku, DPCard, DPVale, Beel) plus OXXO cash references behind a single charge protocol with per-gateway error capture.

Carrier Integrations: Built the Altán Redes provisioning integration (~40 operations), SFTP batch ingestion of CDR reports, a second MVNE (OXIO), number portability and CFDI/SAT e-invoicing — 18 vendor clients standardized on one contract.

Reliability & Correctness: Engineered a 26-reason retailer balance ledger with pessimistic locking, an anti-fraud rate limiter with six configurable rules, retries with exponential backoff, and concurrency-capped job queues (95 jobs / 18 queues) tuned to carrier API limits.

AWS Cloud Infrastructure: Designed and operated multi-AZ, high-availability AWS infrastructure for ~28 brands and 100+ deployments — EC2 Auto Scaling behind ELB, Multi-AZ RDS (PostgreSQL), S3 + CloudFront, Route 53 with health-check failover, VPC isolation and CloudWatch monitoring.

Mobile Leadership: Led the Kotlin Multiplatform migration, authoring 63% of the codebase — Clean Architecture + MVVM with 54 use cases and 43 screens shared across Android and iOS; automated white-label releases via fastlane with Vault-injected secrets.

Standards & Mentorship: Established GitLab CI with RSpec (432 specs), RuboCop, Brakeman/Snyk SAST, an 8,423-line OpenAPI spec and OpenTelemetry tracing across 146 releases; mentored engineers and led architecture decisions across backend, mobile and frontend.
